passage.title: Master communication capstone
target: The student combines a glossary explanation, a briefing, and a written summary.
Key terms: synthesis, evidence, qualification, unresolved question.
Student: My summary separates evidence from unresolved questions.
Student: Which claim needs a qualification?
Instructor: Your source does not confirm one detail. Qualify that claim and explain what follow-up is needed.
Student: I need clarification.
Student: Let me check my understanding.
Student: Which details are confirmed?
Student: I will summarize the main points.
If the time changes, I will confirm it.
Unless the time changes, we will use this schedule.
The speaker marks the unresolved detail before giving the handoff.
The partner asks a follow-up question to check the explanation.
They compare their understanding before closing the conversation.
